svg.title: Logger alone vs logger with unolog
svg.desc: Same 12 fields, output discarded: slog, zap, and zerolog alone, and the same loggers end to end through unolog. Base bars are the logger-alone floor; the mint cap is what unolog adds.

svg.text: Means of 25 runs in one session (Sep 2026). Mint is unolog's end-to-end share on top of each logger's own floor — core, bridge, and encoding for one reusable record.
